trigger: Post-freeze literature/protocol review identified that Gulf Coast and Great Plains NAAMP programmes targeted surveys within three days of rainfall.

secondary_result.interpretation: All point estimates positive; alpha and gamma imprecise.

authorized_interpretation: The headline multiscale association is not confined to comparisons entirely inside the NAAMP 0-3 day rain-target window.
unchanged_boundaries: programme scheduling and time-varying confounding are not eliminated
no long-duration rainfall endpoint is authorized
